name: Abhishek Chaudhary
summary:
AI Engineer with hands-on experience building LLM-powered, multimodal, and GenAI systems. Strong background in transformer
fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, document intelligence, and production-grade deployment across healthcare and travel domains using
PyTorch, Hugging Face, and cloud-based inference.
company_details: 1. AI Engineer @ Digiquanta / Mondee (Dec 2024 - Oct 2025) [conf 0.98, review=False]
2. Backend Developer Intern @ Enthuons Technologies Pvt. Ltd (Jan 2024 - Jun 2024) [conf 0.98, review=False]

responsibilities: Designed and deployed LLM-driven autonomous travel agents for flight/hotel search, itinerary generation, and personal- ized recommendations.
Built multimodal medical document intelligence pipelines using Qwen 2.5-VL and Llama 3.1, automating 95% of manual data extraction.
Fine-tuned LayoutLMv3 for document classification and field extraction, achieving 98% accuracy and reducing QA effort by 90%.
Trained and optimized YOLO-based vision models for handwritten signature detection with 95% precision on scanned medical forms.
Created a patient risk scoring and rehospitalization prediction models, reaching 75% predictive accuracy.
Implemented RAG pipelines with semantic chunking and embedding-based retrieval to improve factual accuracy of LLM responses.
Implemented a multilingual AI medical assistant (English, Hindi, Telugu) with sub-10s inference latency using OpenAI and Gemini APIs.
Improved flight and hotel price prediction accuracy by 30% through feature engineering and ensemble learning.
Developed and deployed 12+ RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js, supporting 1,000+ requests/min.
Optimized database queries, middleware, and error handling, reducing backend failures by 20%.
Collaborated in Agile sprints, contributing to code reviews, debugging, and version control using Git and GitHub.

Achievements: Finalist, Code Gladiators 2024 – Rank 191 among 35,000+ participants
projects: • Built an end-to-end GenAI pipeline for script generation, avatar-based video synthesis, and TTS using Gemini and D-ID.
• Developed a React-based frontend with Node.js backend to deliver automated, multilingual AI-generated video content.
• Fine-tuned transformer models on 15K+ dialogue samples using PyTorch and Hugging Face.
• Improved summary coherence and relevance by 20% ROUGE score through preprocessing and hyperparameter tuning.
